title: xhcw-1998-world-heavyweight-title
label: The Juice

won.source: Won from "Sadistic" Steve Liermann at Awakening, 26 November 2001 (the promotion's own already-served broadcast).

how: Won the title from "Sadistic" Steve Liermann at Awakening.
note: Retained against Duff Man at Retribution, 7 January 2002, with outside help from Absolute Power; lost to Adam Simon at Unleashed, 16 March 2002, when Ramsus Palantiri distracted him.

title: xhcw-1998-world-heavyweight-title
label: Adam Simon

won.source: Won from The Juice at Unleashed, 16 March 2002, after Ramsus Palantiri (aligned with DeX) distracted Juice.

how: Won the World Heavyweight Championship from The Juice at Unleashed.
note: Retained over Vincent Lyons at Assault, 7 April 2002.

title: xhcw-1998-world-hardcore-title
label: The Dehibilitator

won.source: The Dehibilitator's own words at Retribution, 7 January 2002: he had held the title "two months", his "entire XHCW tenure".

note: Retained against "Ironman" James Loyal in a Last Man Standing Match at Retribution, and again through the winter, before losing to Nailz at Unleashed, 16 March 2002.

title: xhcw-1998-world-tag-team-title
label: John Sebastion and Scotty Fitzpatrick

won.source: Retribution, 7 January 2002.

how: Won a Double Dog Collar Match over Jolted and Frost, made a title match on the spot.
note: Retained once by leaving the arena with the belts, 19 January 2002; lost to Adam Simon and 2Short at Counterstrike, 9 February 2002.

title: xhcw-1998-world-tag-team-title
label: Adam Simon and 2Short

won.source: Won from John Sebastion and Scotty Fitzpatrick in a Weapons Match at Counterstrike, 9 February 2002, billed as "Short and Long."

how: Won the World Tag Team Championship from John Sebastion and Scotty Fitzpatrick at Counterstrike.

title: xhcw-1998-world-light-heavyweight-title
label: Kletus Casady

won.source: Retribution, 7 January 2002.

how: Won a Cage Match over 2Short.
note: Lost to Chris Cage in a Weapons Match, 19 January 2002.

title: xhcw-1998-world-light-heavyweight-title
label: Chris Cage

won.source: Won from Kletus Casady in a Weapons Match, 19 January 2002.

how: Won the World Light Heavyweight Championship from Kletus Casady.
note: Retained over Kletus Casady in a Roofed Cage Match, 2 February 2002, and over Kletus Casady and Skullberry in a 3-way "Wood, Steel and Wire" Match at Counterstrike, 9 February 2002.

title: xhcw-1998-world-television-title
label: Chris Jacobson

won.source: Retribution, 7 January 2002.

how: Beat Chris Cage.
note: Lost to Moose in a Dog Collar Match, 13 January 2002.

title: xhcw-1998-world-television-title
label: Moose

won.source: Won from Chris Jacobson in a Dog Collar Match, 13 January 2002.

how: Won the World Television Championship from Chris Jacobson.
note: A battle-royal announcer at Counterstrike also called him champion again mid-show, but the same night's separately staged "Final Battleground Match" is the documented transition to Steve Liermann.

title: xhcw-1998-transatlantic-title
label: Adam Simon

won.source: Retribution, 7 January 2002.

how: Won a Texas Death Match over Pico Flush.
note: Lost a 3-way Falls Count Anywhere Match to Brad Jones and John Sebastion at the Silverdome, 2 February 2002.

title: xhcw-1998-transatlantic-title
label: Brad Jones

won.source: Won a 3-way Falls Count Anywhere Match from Adam Simon and John Sebastion at the Silverdome, 2 February 2002, eliminating Sebastion first.

how: Won the TransAtlantic Championship from Adam Simon and John Sebastion.

title: xhcw-1998-world-heavyweight-title
label: Brad Jones

won.source: Won from Adam Simon at Affliction, 28 April 2002, with a Sharpshooter and Steve Liermann's help.

how: Won the World Heavyweight Championship from Adam Simon at Affliction.

title: xhcw-1998-world-heavyweight-title
label: Duff Man

won.source: Won from Vincent Lyons, wrestling as "Aftermath," at Hardcore Harvest, 24 October 2002, after Steve Liermann's own betrayal — a bat shot — turned the match his way.

how: Won the World Heavyweight Championship from Vincent Lyons at Hardcore Harvest.

title: xhcw-1998-world-heavyweight-title
label: "Sadistic" Steve Liermann

won.source: Already champion on the promotion's own Assault of 1 November 2001, retaining there against Scotty Fitzpatrick.

how: Lost the title to The Juice at Awakening, 26 November 2001.

title: xhcw-1998-world-heavyweight-title
label: Vincent Lyons

won.source: Took the title from Brad Jones in a match no surviving document records, sometime before Hardcore Harvest.

how: Took the World Heavyweight Championship from Brad Jones.
note: Wrestled under the alter-ego "Aftermath" when he lost the title to Duff Man at Hardcore Harvest, 24 October 2002.

title: xhcw-1998-world-hardcore-title
label: Nailz

won.source: Won from The Dehibilitator in a Roofed Glass Cage Match at Unleashed, 16 March 2002.

how: Won the World Hardcore Championship from The Dehibilitator at Unleashed.
note: Retained over The Scorpio at Assault, 7 April 2002; a Scaffold Match against The Dehibilitator at Affliction, 28 April 2002, ended without a pinfall when The Dehibilitator fell through a broken railing, so the title did not change hands there.

title: xhcw-1998-world-hardcore-title
label: Reverend Death

won.source: Took the title from Nailz in a match no surviving document records, sometime before Hardcore Harvest.

how: Took the World Hardcore Championship from Nailz.
note: Retained over Micheal Graves in an Xtreme Tables, Ladders and Chairs Match at Hardcore Harvest, 24 October 2002.

title: xhcw-1998-world-tag-team-title
label: Moose and Anthony Dolarhyde

won.source: Won a four-way dance at Hardcore Harvest, 24 October 2002, with manager Paul Wade's interference.

how: Won the World Tag Team Championship in a four-way dance at Hardcore Harvest.

title: xhcw-1998-world-tag-team-title
label: Jolted and Frost

won.source: No surviving document dates their own win.

how: Lost to John Sebastion and Scotty Fitzpatrick in a Double Dog Collar Match at Retribution.

title: xhcw-1998-world-light-heavyweight-title
label: Spiral

won.source: Won the World Light Heavyweight Championship from Chris Cage at Hardcore Harvest, 24 October 2002, appearing already in possession of the belt as a mystery opponent.

how: Won the title from Chris Cage at Hardcore Harvest.

title: xhcw-1998-world-light-heavyweight-title
label: 2Short

won.source: No surviving document dates her own win.

how: Lost to Kletus Casady in a Cage Match at Retribution.

title: xhcw-1998-world-light-heavyweight-title
label: Ramsus Palantiri

won.source: Took the title from Chris Cage in a match no surviving document records, sometime before Unleashed.

how: Took the World Light Heavyweight Championship from Chris Cage.
note: Retained over Super Skit at Unleashed, 16 March 2002, and over The Scorpio in a Steel Cage main event, 30 March 2002.

title: xhcw-1998-world-light-heavyweight-title
label: Chris Cage

won.source: Took the title back from Ramsus Palantiri in a match no surviving document records, sometime before Hardcore Harvest.

how: Took the World Light Heavyweight Championship back from Ramsus Palantiri.
note: Lost the title at Hardcore Harvest, 24 October 2002, to a mystery opponent revealed as a new challenger, Spiral, who somehow already held his belt.

title: xhcw-1998-world-television-title
label: "Sadistic" Steve Liermann

won.source: Won from Moose in Counterstrike's own "Final Battleground Match," 9 February 2002, with a debuting Khan turning on Moose to help him.

how: Won the World Television Championship from Moose at Counterstrike.
note: Retained over Duff Man in a Roofed Cage Match at Unleashed, 16 March 2002, and over Trevor Finnell and Chris Cage in a 3-way Match, 30 March 2002.

title: xhcw-1998-world-television-title
label: Duff Man

won.source: Won a "Career vs. Title" Match from Steve Liermann at Affliction, 28 April 2002, with The Juice turning on Liermann to help him.

how: Won the World Television Championship from Steve Liermann at Affliction.

title: xhcw-1998-world-television-title
label: Fudgey McGlone

won.source: Won the World Television Championship from Kryptonic at Hardcore Harvest, 24 October 2002.

how: Won the title from Kryptonic at Hardcore Harvest.

title: xhcw-1998-world-television-title
label: Chris Cage

won.source: No surviving document dates his own win.

how: Lost to Chris Jacobson at Retribution.

title: xhcw-1998-world-television-title
label: Kryptonic

won.source: Took the title from Duff Man in a match no surviving document records, sometime before Hardcore Harvest.

how: Took the World Television Championship from Duff Man.
note: Lost the title to Fudgey McGlone at Hardcore Harvest, 24 October 2002.

title: xhcw-1998-transatlantic-title
label: Vincent Lyons

won.source: Won an eight-man tournament final over Fear at Affliction, 28 April 2002, for the vacant title.

how: Won the vacant TransAtlantic Championship in an eight-man tournament at Affliction.

title: xhcw-1998-transatlantic-title
label: Pico Flush

won.source: No surviving document dates his own win.

how: Lost a Texas Death Match to Adam Simon at Retribution.

title: xhcw-1998-transatlantic-title
label: Ramsus Palantiri

won.source: Took the title from Vincent Lyons in a match no surviving document records, sometime before Hardcore Harvest.

how: Took the TransAtlantic Championship from Vincent Lyons.
note: Dropped the title to the mat himself at the opening of Hardcore Harvest, 24 October 2002, declaring it beneath him; no document shows anyone taking it up afterward.
